## ⚠️ IMPORTANT SECURITY NOTICE ⚠️

**For sensitive security vulnerabilities:**
- **DO NOT** create a public issue
- **Email** security@beast-mode-framework.com instead
- **Wait** for acknowledgment before public disclosure

**Use this template only for:**
- General security improvements
- Security documentation issues
- Non-sensitive security questions
- Security best practices discussions

## Checklist

Before submitting this security issue, please confirm:

- [ ] This is NOT a sensitive security vulnerability requiring private disclosure
- [ ] I have searched existing issues to ensure this is not a duplicate
- [ ] I have provided a clear and descriptive title
- [ ] I have described the security concern and proposed improvements clearly
- [ ] I have considered the impact on different types of users and deployments
- [ ] I have provided specific, actionable suggestions for security improvement
- [ ] I understand that sensitive vulnerabilities should be reported privately

---

**Remember**: For sensitive security vulnerabilities, email security@beast-mode-framework.com instead of creating a public issue.
